gaps.lead: People believe she was the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.explanation: A present belief about a past event: is thought to have + participle.

gaps.lead: Someone stole her bike last week.
gaps.explanation: have something stolen/done = experience it happening to you.

gaps.lead: As well as speaking fluent French, she also speaks Russian.
gaps.explanation: in addition to = as well as.

gaps.lead: 'I will definitely complete the report by Friday,' I said.
gaps.explanation: commit oneself TO + -ing: committed myself to finishing.

gaps.lead: He was sacked for constantly missing deadlines.
gaps.sentence: If he hadn't kept missing deadlines, he ___ sacked.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would(n't) have been + participle.

gaps.lead: 'Did you send the invoice?' the manager asked her.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether she had sent.
